fy_label_note: Baba FY labels equal company fiscal years: UFPI uses a 52/53-week year ending the last Saturday of December (FY2025 ended 2025-12-27). Peers (LPX, WFG, SJ, TREX, BLDR) have December year ends, so no offset. Margin = VA consensus-pivot 'ebitda' / 'revenue' (actuals FY2022-FY2025; FY2026 is consensus estimate). Window FY2022 (peak) to FY2025 (last full actual year). FY2026E consensus is lower still (8.02%), cross-checked below.

company.inputs: FY2022 EBITDA 1,097.448M on revenue 9,626.739M; FY2025 EBITDA 563.560M on 6,320.343M; FY2026E 506.016M on 6,308.714M (8.02%). Pre-cycle FY2019 was 7.19% (317.3M / 4,416.0M), so FY2025 still sits above the pre-boom base. LTM 8.24% from the stage 3 record (UFPI.json).

peers.excluded: CFP (Canfor) dropped: EBITDA margin negative FY2023-FY2025 (-2.05%, -3.24%, -0.70%). Non-North American Forest Products names (AS4, CPBI, DXCO3, SCAB) dropped as different end markets.

attribution_ratio_note: 1218.83 / 248.34 = 4.9079 (decline of the peer median margin). Using the median of per-peer declines (BLDR, 883.10 bps) gives about 3.6. FY2022 to FY2026E window gives 5.18. Caveat: LPX and WFG are commodity OSB and lumber producers whose margins swing with lumber prices far more than a converter like UFPI, which flatters the ratio; the closest business comps split (BLDR fell 883 bps, SJ rose 322 bps, TREX roughly flat).

deciding_facts: Peers fell much more: peer median EBITDA margin fell 1,219 bps FY2022 to FY2025 against UFPI's 248 bps (ratio 4.91), and UFPI's gap to the peer median narrowed from -1,688 bps to -718 bps.

Margin fell with revenue (-34.3%, price-led: Q2 2023 Construction sales -44% = -26% price, -18% units, document_id 91819), and management blames Site Built housing and freight, which the numbers support. FY2025 margin of 8.92% is still above the FY2019 pre-boom 7.19%.
confidence_note: Medium, not high: (1) the peer median leans on commodity producers LPX and WFG; (2) the 2026 leg is margin down on flat revenue (FY2026E 6,308.7M vs 6,320.3M), which management pins on freight, an external cost; (3) there are narrow execution misses (railing placement, Edge operations).
